column1: # Lexeme class `mass_noun`: nouns whose bare singular (without an article) is a normal, complete
# noun phrase (Wasser trinken, Zeit haben, Obst kaufen). Rules: `[class=mass_noun]`,
# `[class:mass_noun=substance]`. Used by the rule for split compounds (den Schnee Mann ->
# Schneemann is only reported when the second noun is not a mass noun) and by agreement rules.
#   substance   materials, food and drink, physical stuff (Wasser, Milch, Geld, Holz, Brot, Strom)
#   abstract    abstract nouns, activities, fields and feelings used without an article
#               (Angst, Zeit, Hunger, Glück, Geduld, Schutz, Hilfe, Musik, Mathematik)
#   collective  collective nouns for a set of things or beings (Obst, Gemüse, Besteck, Gepäck, Vieh)
# Countable nouns (Hund, Tisch, Glas, Tag, Stein) are not members. Nouns with both uses are members
# when the bare singular is normal (Brot essen / ein Brot; Kuchen, Fisch, Wein). Nouns whose bare
# singular occurs only in fixed phrases (Gesellschaft leisten) are not members.
# Order: by value, then by corpus frequency (de/frequency/forms.tsv), frequent first.
# Written from own knowledge of German (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
